sources.snippet: Truss The simplest way to serve AI/ML models in production Truss is the CLI for deploying and serving ML models on Baseten. Package your model's serving logic in Python, launch training jobs, and deploy to production—Truss handles containerization, dependency management, and GPU configuration.

sources.title: basetenlabs/truss-examples | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The truss-examples repository serves as a comprehensive collection of machine learning model deployment examples built on the Truss framework and optimized for the Baseten platform. This repository demonstrates production-ready deployments across multiple ML model categories using various serving frameworks, with automated configuration generation and continuous integration testing.
